applicability: repositories whose review signal is an asynchronous bot pass. A blocking required-review gate mechanically covers the merge half only; the completion-reporting half still applies there, since no gate stops a coordinator calling the task done before the passes land
destination: AGENTS.md Opening a pull request (automated review lands after you open)
expected_behavior: A pull request is not reported finished, and not merged, until the automated review passes have landed on the current head and every comment is dispositioned as applied or declined with a reason. Applying a comment writes new bytes, so the passes that cleared the previous head do not cover them and the last review-driven edit owes another wait.
observation: This repository's automated review posts two to five minutes after a pull request is opened. A PR merged four minutes after opening was reverted when its P1 landed two minutes after the merge.
reason: Operator approved the destination edit 2026-08-11 after the second occurrence; the rule ships in the same change that records it.

sources.source_reference: PR #121 reported finished at open; three valid comments landed 03:17-03:19Z

scope: pull request completion reporting and merge timing

sensitivity_review.statement: Operator attested that the candidate contains no raw transcripts, secrets, credentials, or executable instructions.
